summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: data modeling for historical analytics and cloud infrastructure upgrades. For the former, a plan was discussed to model data back to pre-March last year for JCD Brazil using an API pull method, which requires coordination with someone named Galina. The specific modeling approach (date/time handling or forecasting) needs confirmation.

Regarding infrastructure, several changes were implemented: upgrading storage from standard cold to st1 due to perceived performance benefits and cost savings. Additionally, the total capacity was increased by 100 GB, and a new dedicated table, `device_session_trusted`, was created on hot storage for client-facing session data, allowing other general sessions to be moved to cold storage.
decisions: Switching cold storage type from standard to st1
Adding 100 GB of total storage capacity
Creating a dedicated `device_session_trusted` table on hot storage for client-facing session data
action_items: The infrastructure changes (storage type switch and capacity increase) must wait until Saturday due to the need for a system reboot.
